title: Christian Hope
definition: Christian hope is confident expectation in God's promises, especially the return of Christ, resurrection, and eternal life with Him.
summary: Hope is not wishful thinking. It is grounded in God's faithfulness, Christ's resurrection, and the promises of Scripture.
christFocus: Christ is the anchor of hope for His people in life, suffering, and death.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Hope is not wishful thinking. It is grounded in God's faithfulness, Christ's resurrection, and the promises of Scripture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
